items.raw_excerpt: A woman autorickshaw driver in Kochi alleges union discrimination, resulting in her reinstatement after media attention highlighted her plight.
items.summary_en: A woman autorickshaw driver in Kochi said a union denied her the right to work. After the media shared her story, she was reinstated.
items.summary_ko: 코치의 한 여성 오토릭샤 운전기사가 노조의 차별로 일할 권리를 빼앗겼다고 주장했습니다. 언론이 그 사연을 알리면서 다시 일자리를 되찾았습니다.
items.title_en: Woman auto driver in Kochi gets her job back after union dispute

items.title_original: Woman auto driver, allegedly denied right to work, reinstated in Kerala’s Kochi

items.raw_excerpt: Members of three unions have downed tools for 24 hours at BHP's Port Hedland operations, after a work stoppage by the Australian Workers Union a day earlier.
items.summary_en: Workers at BHP's Port Hedland operations stopped work for 24 hours. It is the second time in two days that workers have downed tools. The Australian Workers Union held a stoppage a day earlier.
items.summary_ko: BHP의 포트헤들랜드 현장에서 노동자들이 24시간 동안 작업을 중단했다. 하루 전 호주노동조합의 작업 중지에 이어 이틀 연속 작업 중단이 이어졌다.
items.title_en: Workers down tools for second time at BHP's Port Hedland operations

items.raw_excerpt: The technique has been used to increase circulation and in some cases reduce fluid buildup. Whether it tightens and brightens your skin is less clear.
items.summary_en: Lymphatic drainage massage is used to improve circulation and reduce fluid buildup. Whether it actually tightens and brightens your skin is less clear. Experts say the skin benefits are not fully proven.

items.raw_excerpt: This week, elected officials voted to establish a land reserve on the grounds of Sanair, a 57-year-old racetrack in Saint-Pie, Que. The site is being considered for a new high school.
items.summary_en: Town leaders in Saint-Pie, Quebec voted to set aside the land of Sanair, a 57-year-old racetrack. They want to build a new high school there. Not everyone in town likes the idea.

items.title_en: Turn a racetrack into a school? The idea divides a Quebec town

items.raw_excerpt: Knaresborough is one of North Yorkshire's most charming towns - a perfect day trip with a castle, caves, river views and a market
items.summary_en: Knaresborough is one of North Yorkshire's most charming towns. It is a perfect day trip with a castle, caves, river views and a market. Many visitors keep coming back to this lovely town.

items.raw_excerpt: Thadi village rehabilitation begins as 56 acres identified for relocation amid pollution concerns, ensuring residents receive essential amenities.
items.summary_en: Thadi village will be moved to a new location. Authorities found 56 acres of land for the move. Residents will get basic amenities because of pollution concerns in the area.
items.summary_ko: 타디 마을이 새로운 곳으로 이주하게 된다. 당국은 이주를 위해 56에이커의 땅을 확보했다. 지역의 오염 문제 때문에 주민들은 필수 편의시설을 제공받게 된다.
items.title_en: Thadi village moves to a new place
items.title_original: Thadi village rehabilitation process set in motion

items.raw_excerpt: A water tanker and portable toilets are being installed around the central North Island town of Ohakune as water supplies come under threat.
items.summary_en: A water pipe broke in Ohakune, a small town in New Zealand's central North Island. The town's water supply is now at risk. Officials are putting water tankers and portable toilets on the streets while they fix the problem.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 북섬 중부의 작은 마을 오하쿠네에서 물관이 터져 수도 공급이 위협받고 있습니다. 당국은 문제를 고치는 동안 거리에 급수차와 이동 화장실을 설치하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Water tankers and toilets set up in Ohakune after pipe breaks

items.raw_excerpt: El cuadro loíno tiene solo un punto más que su escolta, Santiago Wanderers.
items.summary_en: Cobreloa drew with Iquique and stayed at the top of Chile's second-division football league. The Calama club has only one point more than its closest rival, Santiago Wanderers.

items.summary_en: The Curitiba Symphony Orchestra will close the first Santa Felicidade Gastronomic Festival this Saturday at 6:30 pm. The concert will take place at Madalosso. It brings classical music to a local food event.

items.raw_excerpt: In Maharashtra’s drought-prone regions, widow remarriage is gradually shifting from a social taboo to wider acceptance.
items.summary_en: In Maharashtra's drought-prone areas, widow remarriage is slowly becoming more accepted. But some farm widows in Vidarbha choose not to remarry. Their choice shows how an old social taboo is changing.
items.summary_ko: 가뭄이 잦은 마하라슈트라 주에서는 과부의 재혼이 점차 받아들여지고 있다. 하지만 비다르바의 농가 과부들 가운데는 재혼을 거부하는 사람도 있다. 그들의 선택은 오래된 사회적 금기가 변해 가는 모습을 보여 준다.
items.title_en: Vidarbha's farm widows who refuse to remarry

items.summary_en: A stay-at-home mum from Cornwall now goes to music festivals with her son. They love going to gigs together and share very similar music tastes. She also works as an Oxfam campaigner at the events.
